scope: All recently released frontier/general or coding-specialized text models, including official API, hosted open weights and self-hosted deployments. Tool-capable text models are broad discovery hints, not proof of coding suitability. The 2026-10-09 update only rechecks selected configuration profiles, input limits and pricing scopes; the 2026-10-10 update only rechecks the Haiku 5.5 cost-first compaction profile. The broad release inventory remains the 2026-10-08 review, with vendor coverage still partial. Stable paid-tier coding model, generally available on 2026-10-13. Input, thinking and output share 1,048,576 tokens; model output records long-decode capacity up to the remaining window, while the Gemini binding caps current streaming requests at 65,536 tokens. Long decode requires continuation handling, which current Chord does not implement; direct non-streaming REST requests stop at 32,768. Thinking levels are low, medium (default) and high. On the configured Gemini API route, legacy thinking_budget maps to a level with a warning; minimal is unsupported. Explicit caching is unsupported and sampling parameters are ignored. Standard pricing is $4/$20 per million input/output tokens from 2026-12-01, with $2/$10 introductory rates through 2026-11-30. Live smoke checks on 2026-10-14: chord doctor models, gemini preset, wire ID gemini-4-argon, medium level, streaming GenerateContent at https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/. The direct attempt timed out; a subsequent attempt through the existing local SOCKS proxy reached the API but returned HTTP 429 with free-tier quota limit 0 for this model. No completion, low/high variants or long decode were verified. The binding's streaming cap is documentation-backed; the live check is quota-blocked.
